A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Generator Matching work and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and appendices A–I. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching; appendix content is unchanged.

before.justification: v2 reports original image and protein generation results, checkerboard experiments in Appendix E, and alternative-loss experiments in Appendix I.

after.justification: v3 retains the original image, protein, checkerboard, and alternative-loss results, including Tables 2, 3, and 5 and Figure 10.

M1.justification: The generator constructions, conditional training objectives, jump models, superpositions, multimodal composition, and Algorithms 1–2 are retained. The rewritten sampling explanation introduces no procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR10, ImageNet32 with blurred faces, unimodal and multimodal protein generation, and synthetic checkerboard distributions. The new main-text pointers to Appendices E and I refer to existing experiments.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains DDPM, VP-SDE, EDM, and the same flow/jump comparisons. Tables 3 and 5 retain the same protein baselines, including FoldFlow and MultiFlow. Appendix I retains the same loss-function comparisons.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings and metrics are unchanged, including image sampler comparisons, the protein protocol with 100 NFEs and 400 samples in Appendix G.4, checkerboard NFE sweeps, and Appendix I's dopri5 evaluation.

E4.justification: The sampler comparisons, probability-path and discretization analyses in Appendix E, and alternative-loss study in Appendix I already appear in v2. Section 9 adds a pointer to these analyses, without new ablations or robustness evidence.

E5.justification: The same point estimates and training curves are reported. v3 introduces no run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or changed uncertainty-reporting practices.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains mixed Jump + Flow FIDs of 2.36 on CIFAR10 and 3.33 on ImageNet32; Appendix I retains the 2.62 versus 2.54 loss-comparison result.

T1.justification: Theorems, propositions, assumptions, and appendix proofs are unchanged. Equation (1) expresses the same marginal distribution through hierarchical sampling. Table 1 spells out positive semidefiniteness already defined in Theorem 1, rather than changing the constraint.

C1.justification: The central claims about unification, generator and loss characterization, jump models, superpositions, and multimodal modeling remain intact. The revised abstract and contribution list describe the same capabilities and empirical applications.

C2.justification: The Section 2 remark broadens stated conditioning applicability from the specific start/end-point case to more general latent variables. This is a limited applicability clarification; experimental interpretations and substantive limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation, sampling, hyperparameter, and loss details in Appendices F, G, and I are unchanged, as are the pretrained-model and repository access information. New acknowledgments provide contributor credit without new reproducibility instructions.

R1.justification: The bibliography contains the same works. Section 8 and Appendix H retain the same relationships to diffusion, flow matching, stochastic interpolants, and prior Markov generative models; wording edits do not substantively reposition the work.

P1.justification: v3 revises portions of the abstract, contribution list, and probability-path explanation, tightens prose, adds appendix-study pointers and acknowledgments, and updates the publication header. The overall section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 expands the diffusion-parameter entry into explicit matrix dimensions and a positive-semidefinite label. Typographic emphasis, headers, and reference pagination change slightly. Figures, empirical table structures, and appendix body layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves clarity through the sampling and endpoint explanations in Section 2, explicit diffusion notation in Table 1, and pointers to existing appendix experiments in Section 9. These improve accessibility and navigation; methods, proofs, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
